title: Top 5 In-Demand IT Skills for 2026
author: G-TEC Admin
excerpt: The technology landscape is evolving rapidly. Discover the most sought-after skills employers are looking for in 2026 and how G-TEC prepares you for them.
content:
The technology landscape is evolving rapidly. In 2026, the most in-demand IT skills include:

1. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
AI is transforming every industry. Understanding ML algorithms, neural networks, and tools like TensorFlow are highly valued.

2. Cloud Computing
AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud certifications are among the most-sought credentials globally.

3. Cybersecurity
With rising data breaches, certified ethical hackers and security analysts are critical.

4. Full-Stack Web Development
Proficiency in React, Node.js, and databases continues to command premium salaries.

5. Data Analytics
Businesses rely on data-driven decisions. SQL, Power BI, and Python for analytics are foundational.

title: How Tally ERP 9 & GST Certification Can Boost Your Career
author: G-TEC Admin
excerpt: Tally ERP 9 with GST is one of the most used accounting software in India. Learn how certification can open doors to top accounting and finance roles.
content:
Tally ERP 9 with GST is one of the most popular accounting software solutions used by businesses across India. Here's why getting certified matters:

✅ Industry Adoption
Over 2 million businesses in India use Tally ERP. Certification makes you immediately employable.

✅ GST Compliance
Since the implementation of GST, accountants who understand both Tally and GST are in extremely high demand.

✅ Salary Advantage
Certified Tally professionals earn 20–40% more than non-certified counterparts in similar roles.

✅ Freelance Opportunities
Many small businesses outsource their accounting. A Tally certificate opens the door to lucrative freelance gigs.

G-TEC offers a comprehensive Tally ERP 9 + GST course with real-world case studies and placement support. Join our next batch!
